title: Shared definitions for the content schemas

id.description: Permanent: never renamed, never deleted (D44). Lower case, words joined by hyphens, and the same as the file name.

text.description: Player-facing English text. `npm run content` moves it into the string table (D46).

icon.description: The sprite's name. Without one, the kind's default icon is used (R15.5).

retired.description: Removed from the game, but old saves still understand it (D44).

weight.description: How likely, relative to the other entries in the same list.

oneOf.description: Everything in a shared list from content/tables/.

add.description: A whole number, or a die rolled each time the effect applies (D48).
